[Pantheon Magic](/Feats.aspx?ID=5368) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Minotaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=788" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 43

</column>

---

The touch of divine meddling still runs through you, whether you want it or not. Choose one [cantrip](/Traits.aspx?ID=550) from the [divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2) spell list. You can cast this cantrip as a divine innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
